tasks.label: Pull and Validate New Logs (last 48 hours)
tasks.detail: Pull every unvalidated private full-rate route from the device newer than 48 hours and run the Odyssey validator.

tasks.label: Run Jotpluggler
tasks.detail: Open the standard Odyssey tuning layout for a local route or segment.

tasks.label: Run Cabana
tasks.detail: Open Cabana for a local route or stream live CAN from the device.
tasks.command: ARG="${input:cabanaArg}" && uv run scons openpilot/tools/cabana/_cabana openpilot/cereal/messaging/bridge && if [ "$ARG" = "live" ]; then uv run openpilot/tools/cabana/_cabana --zmq tcp://192.168.1.200; else uv run openpilot/tools/cabana/_cabana "$ARG"; fi

tasks.label: Deploy ody-op-long to device
tasks.detail: Run Odyssey preflash checks, publish the clean matched parent/submodule branch, build it on the device, and reboot.
tasks.command: cd /Users/travisbadgley/openpilot && CURRENT_BRANCH=ody-op-long && test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "$CURRENT_BRANCH" || { echo "Refusing to deploy: checkout $CURRENT_BRANCH in openpilot first."; exit 1; } && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo 'Refusing to deploy: openpilot has uncommitted changes.'; git status --short; exit 1; } && test -z "$(git -C opendbc_repo status --porcelain)" || { echo 'Refusing to deploy: opendbc_repo has uncommitted changes.'; git -C opendbc_repo status --short; exit 1; } && test "$(git -C opendbc_repo branch --show-current)" = "$CURRENT_BRANCH" || { echo 'Refusing to deploy: parent and opendbc_repo branches differ.'; exit 1; } && test "$(git ls-tree HEAD opendbc_repo | awk '{print $3}')" = "$(git -C opendbc_repo rev-parse HEAD)" || { echo 'Refusing to deploy: parent opendbc pin does not match the checked-out submodule.'; exit 1; } && git diff --check && git -C opendbc_repo diff --check && .venv/bin/python .agents/preflash.py && git -C opendbc_repo push origin "$CURRENT_BRANCH" && git push origin "$CURRENT_BRANCH" && ssh comma@192.168.1.200 "bash -l -c \"cd /data/openpilot && (git remote set-url origin https://github.com/brikowski/openpilot.git || git remote add origin https://github.com/brikowski/openpilot.git) && tools/op.sh switch origin $CURRENT_BRANCH && tools/op.sh build && (sudo reboot &) && exit 0\""

tasks.label: Deploy ody-sp-staging to device
tasks.detail: Publish the clean matched sunnypilot staging parent/submodule branch, build it on the device, and reboot.
tasks.command: cd /Users/travisbadgley/sunnypilot && CURRENT_BRANCH=ody-sp-staging && test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "$CURRENT_BRANCH" || { echo "Refusing to deploy: checkout $CURRENT_BRANCH in sunnypilot first."; exit 1; } && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo 'Refusing to deploy: sunnypilot has uncommitted changes.'; git status --short; exit 1; } && test -z "$(git -C opendbc_repo status --porcelain)" || { echo 'Refusing to deploy: sunnypilot opendbc_repo has uncommitted changes.'; git -C opendbc_repo status --short; exit 1; } && test "$(git -C opendbc_repo branch --show-current)" = "$CURRENT_BRANCH" || { echo 'Refusing to deploy: parent and opendbc_repo branches differ.'; exit 1; } && test "$(git ls-tree HEAD opendbc_repo | awk '{print $3}')" = "$(git -C opendbc_repo rev-parse HEAD)" || { echo 'Refusing to deploy: parent opendbc pin does not match the checked-out submodule.'; exit 1; } && git diff --check && git -C opendbc_repo diff --check && git -C opendbc_repo push origin "$CURRENT_BRANCH" && git push origin "$CURRENT_BRANCH" && ssh comma@192.168.1.200 "bash -l -c \"cd /data/openpilot && (git remote set-url origin https://github.com/brikowski/openpilot.git || git remote add origin https://github.com/brikowski/openpilot.git) && tools/op.sh switch origin $CURRENT_BRANCH && tools/op.sh build && (sudo reboot &) && exit 0\""
